reason: Two of my bigger clients just cut their orders, and 3,500 up front plus 1,800 a month is a big chunk of what I take home in a year, with no meetings promised. I run an agency, so I can set up Apollo and a couple of domains myself, or get a junior to do it, for a lot less.
objection: No meetings are guaranteed, so I could spend over 14,000 euros by month six and still be waiting. Words like 'revenue architecture' and 'engine' read like consulting fluff for things I already know how to do.
would_change_my_mind: Pay per qualified meeting, or a guarantee that I get the sprint money back if no meetings come in 60 days, from a team that has done this for other small agencies.
